name: SEBI CSCRF 2024
description: SEBI Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework — tiered (Tier 1/2/3) obligations for regulated entities in Indian securities markets (2024 circular, phased applicability).

categories.name: Tier 1 — all market infrastructure and regulated entities

controls.name: CISO designation
controls.req: Designate a CISO with defined responsibilities accountable to the Board/senior management.

controls.name: Cybersecurity policy framework
controls.req: Board-approved cybersecurity and cyber-resilience policy covering prevention, detection, response, recovery.

controls.name: Annual vulnerability assessment + pentest
controls.req: Conduct VAPT annually (and on significant changes) with findings remediated and reported.

controls.name: Incident reporting
controls.req: Report cybersecurity incidents to SEBI within 6 hours of detection/doubt, and to CERT-In/sectoral CERTs as applicable.

controls.name: Log retention
controls.req: Retain security logs (network, server, application, database) for 180 days; maintain audit trail.

controls.name: MFA / credential hygiene
controls.req: Enforce MFA for remote access, privileged users and system administrators; timely password rotation for default creds.

controls.name: Data backup and recovery
controls.req: Maintain backups with tested recovery (RPO/RTO defined per criticality), air-gapped/offline copies.

controls.name: Data classification + encryption
controls.req: Classify data (public/confidential/secret) with mapping; encrypt data at rest and in transit.

controls.name: Cyber insurance
controls.req: Evaluate and maintain cyber insurance coverage appropriate to risk profile.

controls.name: Board reporting
controls.req: Report cybersecurity posture, incidents and remediation status to the Board at defined intervals.

controls.name: Baseline controls catalogue (BCC)
controls.req: Map and self-certify against the BCC: the 10-domain baseline (CSPP, IDS/IPS, E-Discovery, NDR, etc.).

controls.name: CSPP compliance
controls.req: Comply with Comprehensive Security Policy and Procedures (CSPP) for market infrastructure institutionals.

controls.name: E-Discovery + forensics readiness
controls.req: Maintain E-Discovery and digital forensics capabilities/contracts for incident response.

controls.name: Cyber Drills
controls.req: Participate in sectoral cyber drills (SEBI/CERT-In simulated exercises) and act on observations.

controls.name: SOC with monitoring
controls.req: Establish a security operations center (in-house or MSP) with 24x7 monitoring and runbooks.

categories.name: Tier 3 — highest systemic importance (market infrastructure institutions)

controls.name: Independent auditor / CA + concurrent audit
controls.req: Engage independent auditors (CISA-enabled) and concurrent auditors for cybersecurity review.

controls.name: Sectoral CERTS + threat intel sharing
controls.req: Operate sectoral CERTs (e.g. CERC) with threat-intel sharing among MIIs and market participants.

controls.name: MTD + System Resilience drills
controls.req: Conduct maximum tolerable downtime (MTD) mapping and full-scale business continuity/DR drills.

controls.name: APT/insider threat program
controls.req: Sustain an APT and insider-threat program with dedicated tooling and analyst capability.

controls.name: Global/regional intel feed integration
controls.req: Integrate global cyber threat intelligence feeds into detection stack with actionable playbooks.

source: SEBI circular SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-PoD-3/P/CIR/2024/17 (April 2024) — Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework
